title: Born on September 5th: the philosopher who became a president, then gave his birthday away.
caption:
Born on September 5th: the philosopher who became a president, then gave his birthday away.

Born in Tiruttani, Tamil Nadu, in 1888. A philosopher and scholar who became India's Vice President in 1952, then its second President from 1962 to 1967. Awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1954.

When friends and students asked to mark his birthday as President, Radhakrishnan asked instead that the day be dedicated to every teacher in the country. That request became Teachers' Day — observed every September 5th since.

Every teacher shaping the workforce behind India's next 20 years traces back to that one instinct — build something bigger than yourself. That's the same bet Viksit Bharat 2047 is making, at national scale.
